implementation: Sloppy bounded x86-64 dynamic copies through 16 bytes; larger copies retain rep movsb. Not retained in the compiler.
patch:
diff --git a/core/UPSTREAM.json b/core/UPSTREAM.json
index fb05d30a..53cb21dc 100644
--- a/core/UPSTREAM.json
+++ b/core/UPSTREAM.json
@@ -146,6 +146,13 @@
         "compiler/x64.jo"
       ],
       "description": "Adjacent integer compare/select fusion and direct destination-register selects, adapted to Dewy emission; other upstream lowering/optimizer changes are not imported."
+    },
+    {
+      "revision": "06a297d890c6db0ce8f43668e61fd2ba36556336",
+      "paths": [
+        "compiler/x64.jo"
+      ],
+      "description": "Bounded x86-64 dynamic memory copies up to 16 bytes using scalar loads/stores; larger copies retain rep movsb. Allocator, I/O, and string changes are not imported."
     }
   ]
 }
diff --git a/core/compiler/x64.jo b/core/compiler/x64.jo
index ef02a939..3d0e74c2 100644
--- a/core/compiler/x64.jo
+++ b/core/compiler/x64.jo
@@ -1061,6 +1061,42 @@ src_reg = (v: int) -> int:
     if l >= 0: return l
     -1
 
+# copy rcx bytes from rsi to rdi (all caller-saved registers are free: a memcpy is call-like).
+# Up to 16 bytes with two loads and two stores (rep movsb takes some 30 cycles to start where
+# the CPU lacks fast short rep movs), loads before stores (overlap copies as memmove does)
+emit_memcpy = ():
+    bs([0x48, 0x83, 0xF9, 0x10, 0x77, 0])               # cmp rcx, 16; ja big
+    big = code.len() - 1
+    bs([0x48, 0x83, 0xF9, 0x08, 0x72, 0])               # cmp rcx, 8; jb lt8
+    lt8 = code.len() - 1
+    bs([0x48, 0x8B, 0x06, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x54, 0x0E, 0xF8])    # mov rax, [rsi]; mov rdx, [rsi+rcx-8]
+    bs([0x48, 0x89, 0x07, 0x48, 0x89, 0x54, 0x0F, 0xF8])    # mov [rdi], rax; mov [rdi+rcx-8], rdx
+    bs([0xEB, 0])                                       # jmp done
+    d1 = code.len() - 1
+    code[lt8] = u8(code.len() - lt8 - 1)
+    bs([0x48, 0x83, 0xF9, 0x04, 0x72, 0])               # cmp rcx, 4; jb lt4
+    lt4 = code.len() - 1
+    bs([0x8B, 0x06, 0x8B, 0x54, 0x0E, 0xFC])            # mov eax, [rsi]; mov edx, [rsi+rcx-4]
+    bs([0x89, 0x07, 0x89, 0x54, 0x0F, 0xFC])            # mov [rdi], eax; mov [rdi+rcx-4], edx
+    bs([0xEB, 0])                                       # jmp done
+    d2 = code.len() - 1
+    code[lt4] = u8(code.len() - lt4 - 1)
+    bs([0x48, 0x85, 0xC9, 0x74, 0])                     # test rcx, rcx; jz done
+    d3 = code.len() - 1
+    # (1 to 3: the first, middle and last bytes)
+    bs([0x49, 0x89, 0xC8, 0x49, 0xD1, 0xE8])            # mov r8, rcx; shr r8, 1
+    bs([0x0F, 0xB6, 0x06, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0x54, 0x0E, 0xFF])    # movzx eax, [rsi]; movzx edx, [rsi+rcx-1]
+    bs([0x46, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0x0C, 0x06])                  # movzx r9d, [rsi+r8]
+    bs([0x88, 0x07, 0x46, 0x88, 0x0C, 0x07, 0x88, 0x54, 0x0F, 0xFF])    # mov [rdi], al; mov [rdi+r8], r9b; mov [rdi+rcx-1], dl
+    bs([0xEB, 0])                                       # jmp done
+    d4 = code.len() - 1
+    code[big] = u8(code.len() - big - 1)
+    bs([0xF3, 0xA4])                                    # rep movsb
+    loop k in [d1, d2, d3, d4]: code[k] = u8(code.len() - k - 1)
+
+bs = (xs: int[]):
+    loop x in xs: code.push(u8(x & 255))
+
 emit_parallel = (moves: PMove[]):
     pending = moves
     # register to register moves first (with cycle breaking via the stack)
@@ -2206,7 +2242,7 @@ emit_ins = (pos: int, ins: Ins):
         memcpy:
             moves = [PMove(RDI, a), PMove(RSI, bb), PMove(RCX, int(ins.c))]
             emit_parallel(moves)
-            b(0xF3); b(0xA4)
+            emit_memcpy()
         memset:
             moves = [PMove(RDI, a), PMove(RAX, bb), PMove(RCX, int(ins.c))]
             emit_parallel(moves)

reference_stage.purpose: Fixed stage reference; do not replace with a slower implementation.

runtime-pilot.source:
use 'benchmark_harness.jo'
@noinline
copy_kernel = (p: *u8, q: *u8, kind: int, count: int) -> int:
    total = 0
    loop i in [0..count):
        n = (i & 15) + 1
        if kind == 1: n += 16
        else if kind == 2: n += 4096
        p[0] = u8(i & 255)
        mem_copy(q, p, n)
        total += int(q[0]) + int(q[n - 1])
    total
main = () -> int:
    kind = size_argument(args(), 0)
    count = if kind == 2: 500000 else: 20000000
    p = __alloc(8192)
    q = __alloc(8192)
    loop i in [0..8192): p[i] = u8(i % 251)
    start = clock()
    result = copy_kernel(p, q, kind, count)
    stop = clock()
    print("{result} {stop - start}")
    __free(p)
    __free(q)
    0

decision: Targeted short-copy CPU ratio is 0.628 vs the preceding emitter; medium and bulk copies are approximately unchanged. This is not a whole-application gain or a C comparison.

43 of 44 stage comparisons pass. Default match dispatch remains inconclusive after 108 matched samples: ratio 1.01721, bootstrap interval [1.01449, 1.02027]. Stop resampling this candidate; do not label the stage accepted.
Retain the guarded-page copy bounds/live-values tests. Defer the emitter and provenance port, preserving all initial/recheck data.

A separate default-dispatch diagnostic has identical kernel/classifier instructions except call/RIP addresses; classifier moves 128 bytes while its data table stays at the same address. Layout is a plausible source of the small slowdown, not a proven explanation.
Throughput and C/Rust-like runtime goals remain unmet.
